description: HPXML to Home Energy Score Translator is an open-source software project listed in Awesome Sustainable Technology, a curated list of open-source sustainability projects under the section "Buildings and Cities", published or maintained by NREL (repository owner; maintainers as on the project page). This translator script takes an HPXML file or directory of files as an input and generates HEScore inputs from it. Coverage: not geographically bound. The list files it under "Buildings and Cities" (buildings and cities). The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (repository not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support buildings and cities studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-sustainable-technology.
